checklist: If we had ___, we would not have lost ___
items.model_en: Nobody tracked how often the org was used, so we guessed at the numbers every Monday. The cheapest fix here is a weekly report that runs on its own. That would save us four hours a month across the team, and if the report ran on its own, nobody would open the meeting by asking for numbers. We could also keep one branch rule for everything that touches production, even though it slows a small fix by ten minutes. If we had set that rule in January, we would not have lost a day to that rollback.
items.coach_bn: অবস্থা → সমাধান → হিসাব → নজির। চারটা ধাপ, আর প্রতিটাতে একটা করে সংখ্যা।
